text: N258832November 13, 2014CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:N3:359CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6110.20.2079; 6110.30.3059Linda DiamantAnn Taylor Inc.7 Times Square11th FloorNew York, NY 10036RE:	The tariff classification of two women’s garments from China.  Correction to Ruling Number N256326  Dear Ms. Diamant:This replaces Ruling Number N256326, dated September 9, 2014, which contained a clerical error.  The classifications for the two style numbers were transposed.  A complete corrected ruling follows.Style 351921 is a ladies cardigan constructed from 85% cotton and 15% polyester knit fabric.  The stitch count exceeds nine stitches per two centimeters when counted in the direction that the stitches were formed.  The garment features five panels, four of which are sewn together lengthwise in the front.  Additional features include a stand up collar with a snap closure, long hemmed sleeves, vertical pockets at the waist, a full front asymmetrical zipper closure and a banded bottom.  The garment extends from the shoulders to below the waist.  Style 340446 is a ladies fully lined cardigan constructed from 51% acrylic, 28% polyester and 21% wool tweed knit fabric which prevents counting stitches in the direction that the fabric was formed.  The garment features nine panels, five of which are sewn together lengthwise in the front.  Additional features include an asymmetrical neckline, a pieced front yoke, horizontal zippered pockets at the waist, long hemmed sleeves, a full front asymmetrical zipper closure and a straight hemmed bottom.  The garment extends from the shoulders to below the waist. In your ruling request, you recommended classification of the submitted garments under heading 6114, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS).  The Explanatory Notes to heading 6114 states, in part, that this heading covers knitted or crocheted garments which are not included more specifically in the preceding headings of this chapter.  It is noted that style 351921 and 340446 have the styling and necessary coverage of a cardigan-styled garment of 6110, HTSUS. As the submitted garments meet the requirement of heading 6110, heading 6114 cannot be considered.  The applicable subheading for style 351921  will be 6110.20.2079, (HTSUS), which provides for Sweaters, pullovers…and similar articles, knitted or crocheted (con.): of cotton (con.): Other : Other: Other: Women’s or girls’: Other.  The rate of duty will be 16.5 percent ad valorem.The applicable subheading for style 340446 will be 6110.30.3059, (HTSUS), which provides for Sweaters, pullovers…and similar articles, knitted or crocheted (con.) of man-made fibers (con.): Other: Other: Other: Women’s or girls’: Other. The rate of duty will be 32 percent ad valorem.Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on the World Wide Web at http://www.usitc.gov/tata/hts/.This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Renee M. Orsat at renee.orsat@cbp.dhs.gov.Sincerely,Gwenn Klein KirschnerDirectorNational Commodity Specialist Division
